title: OpenAI launches a managed Agents API
friendlyTitle: OpenAI makes it easier to build agents that work for a long time
summary: OpenAI has released the Agents API in public beta, offering the managed harness behind Codex for long-running tasks, tool use, context management, sandboxes, and subagent coordination. Developers can use OpenAI-hosted environments, their own infrastructure, or supported sandbox partners.
friendlySummary: OpenAI has a new API for agents that can use tools, manage files, run code, and keep working across long tasks. Developers can choose where the agent’s work environment runs.
whyItMatters: Teams can build durable agents without assembling every orchestration and runtime component themselves. The trade-off is a deeper platform dependency, so environment control, observability, and exit options still deserve careful review.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can save developers from building a lot of agent infrastructure themselves. Teams should still check costs, security, and how easily they can move to another platform later.
